title: Chapter 366 The Shadow Clan Surrenders
content:
Chapter 366 The Shadow Clan Surrenders

Faced with the action of the Shadow Clan leader, the entire Chaos Realm fell into a brief state of confusion.

They had thought that some races would kneel down to beg for mercy to the human race. After all, the strength of the human race is now there, and it is not unreasonable to kneel down to beg for mercy.

However, the Shadow Clan is one of the six powerful clans in the Chaos Realm!

In the eyes of all living beings in the Chaos Realm, the Shadow Clan, who is high above and calls for wind and rain, is actually the first to beg for mercy.

In the past, they would not believe this.

But now, the facts are in front of you.

The leader of the Shadow Clan really knelt there, and the aura of the Supreme Heaven was not reserved at all.

"Damn it, what is this Shadow Clan doing?!"

"Haha, I've said they are unreliable."

"What an unexpected surprise."

In a certain space, three figures stood here, looking at the Shadow Clan leader in the distance, with different expressions.

But on the other side, the senior management of the Shadow Clan looked at the clan leader who was kneeling on the ground in the distance and gave a thumbs up.

"The patriarch is a good one!"

"In this way, we should be fine."

"Of course, it really doesn't work. We really have to run away."

And at this time, within the human race.

"Lord of the Palace, the leader of the Shadow Clan is here."

A powerful human race man walked into the hall and spoke respectfully to Lu Xue in the hall.

Hearing this, Lu Xue slowly raised her head.

"Shadow Clan?"

"yes."

Lu Xue's eyes moved slightly, and she naturally had some understanding of the Shadow Clan.

The king of the way of space is elusive.

To date, the territory of the Shadow Clan has not been discovered by outsiders.

Unexpectedly, this Shadow Clan will be the first to come.

After a moment of silence, Lu Xue looked up at the human powerhouse in front of her, "Take him in and see me."

"Yes, the Lord of the Palace."

Looking at the leaving human powerhouse, Lu Xue stood up.

At this time, several figures slowly emerged in the dark.

"District Master, what are you going to do with the Shadow Clan?"

Looking at Lu Xue, who looked calm at this moment, An Chang said curiously.

When Lu Xue heard this question, her expression remained unchanged.

"Of course it is for me. This kind of existence that is greedy for life and fear of death is also the best control. You just need to give them a sense of security."

"And this is what the human race lacks the least now."

There are so many top-level people in the human race now, so the sense of security is naturally enough.

And there is also my dad personally at the top, so my sense of security is so full of tremendous sense of security.

By the way, I don’t know what my dad is going to do.

Hearing Lu Xue's words, An Chang nodded slightly, and Wu Shang and Huo Xingzhi on the side also cast admiring eyes.

A tiger father has no dog daughter.

No wonder he was able to become the successor of the Human Emperor.

Not long after, under the leadership of the human strongman, a middle-aged man who looked ordinary slowly came to the hall.

Seeing Lu Xue, the leader of the Shadow Clan did not hesitate and knelt on the ground with a plop.

"Sir, please spare me, my Shadow Clan really knows that I was wrong!"

Looking at the Shadow Clan leader kneeling on the ground, wailing and begging, Lu Xue and the other two couldn't help but twitch their lips slightly.

This kind of guy can also be the patriarch of a clan, and this Shadow Clan is really outrageous.

"You are really the leader of the Shadow Clan?"

Lu Xue couldn't help asking.

Hearing this, the head of the Shadow Clan nodded repeatedly, "It's like a fake one."

As he said that, the space around the shadow clan leader suddenly began to change, and then the surrounding space began to be affected.

The entire hall inside seemed to be in a dream, and the space was constantly folded and compressed.

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue and the other two couldn't help but be shocked.

He is worthy of being known as the king of space.

The control of the way of space has reached such an incredible level.

"alright."

Lu Xue raised her head and interrupted the Shadow Clan leader's display.

If she continues to show it, she will not be able to stand it.

Even if she practices quickly, she is still very weak to the Chaos Realm now.

The reason why I can sit in this position is not because of my identity as the successor of the Human Emperor, but the unfathomable father behind me.

As Lu Xue's voice fell, the space in the hall suddenly returned to its original state.

"Sir, can you prove my identity now."

Lu Xue nodded slightly.

"Since that's the case, I'll just say it."

Suddenly, Lu Xue's eyes instantly became extremely sharp.

She stared at the head of the Shadow Clan and said in a slight voice: "You Shadow Clan secretly broke through countless defense barriers of our human race, causing our human race to almost endanger the disaster of extermination. Just this matter, our human race destroys countless shadow clans. Nothing is an exaggeration.”

Lu Xue's tone had a faint murderous intent, and she kept stabbing into the body of the Shadow Clan leader like a spike, causing the Shadow Clan leader to tremble slightly.

On the side, An Changzai and the three of them consciously took a step forward.

The powerful man above the Supreme Heavenly Emperor directly pressed against the leader of the Shadow Clan.

At this moment, the Shadow Clan leader was already scared and looked deserted.

So, is he bound to die?

But next, Lu Xue's painting style changed, "However, your Shadow Clan still has a chance to atone for his sins."

Hearing this, the head of the Shadow Clan quickly grabbed the last straw and shouted, "Sir, speak quickly. No matter what it is, my Shadow Clan will do it well, and I will never refuse to die!"

Looking at the Shadow Clan leader who was full of desire to survive at this moment, Lu Xue held back her smile and said indifferently: "Join our human race and serve our human race."

"Agree, you can live."

"Don't agree, hehe."

Lu Xue's last sneer made the Shadow Clan leader tremble slightly again.

He nodded and agreed.

"I am willing, my Shadow Clan is willing to join the human race and serve the human race!"

Is this agreed?

Lu Xue was slightly stunned. She thought she had to work harder and coerce and tempt her.

"Don't you need to discuss with your tribe members?"

Lu Xue asked for some reason.

Hearing this, the patriarch of the Shadow Clan smiled awkwardly and said, "No need for this. I am also the patriarch at least, and I still have this power."

As the leader of the Shadow Clan, he naturally has absolute power to do things.

Seeing this, Lu Xue no longer doubted.

"Then from now on, your Shadow Clan will join my human race."

"From now on, just call me the Lord of the Palace."

Hearing this, the Shadow Clan breathed a sigh of relief, and the big stone pressing on his heart finally fell down.

At this time, he seemed to have thought of something and asked quickly, "The Lord of the Palace, do I still need to move here?"

Since he has unified the front with the human race, he may be furiously revenge from the other strong races next.

Even though his Shadow Clan territory is extremely secret, there is still a risk of being found.

So to be on the safe side, it is better to come to the human race.

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded slightly.

"move."

"Senior An."

"Lord of the Palace."

An Chang bowed his hand slightly.

Lu Xue said: "I'll go there when I hand over the handover with the Shadow Clan."

An Chang nodded slightly.

"Happy to serve."
